description.zh: 应用ID列表，单次操作最多支持100个应用ID。
description.en: The list of application IDs. A maximum of 100 application IDs are supported in a single operation.

title.zh: 查询一个EIAM组织可访问的应用列表信息
title.en: Query applications accessible to an EIAM organizational unit

descriptions.zh: 当前接口仅查询组织的直属权限，即直接分配给组织的应用。调用该接口时，可以通过 **ApplicationIds** 参数对应用进行筛选。
descriptions.en: This operation queries only the direct permissions of the organizational unit, that is, applications directly assigned to the organizational unit. When you call this operation, you can use the **ApplicationIds** parameter to filter applications.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam list-applications-for-organizational-unit --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --application-ids app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --organizational-unit-id ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam ListApplicationsForOrganizationalUnit --region cn-hangzhou --OrganizationalUnitId ou_wovwffm62xifdziem7an7xxxxx --PageSize 20 --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PageNumber 1 --ApplicationIds.1 app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
